outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of micrographs (fluorescence images of transfected cells with MitoTracker staining); no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel B includes micrographs plus two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) showing means with error bars but no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image showing HMGB1 and GAPDH bands; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D includes micrographs (SDH/COX staining) plus two bar charts of signal intensity (with N indicated) showing group means and error bars but no individual data points overlaid.

Panel E contains a schematic of the experimental procedure and FACS histogram plots (cell number vs TMRM intensity distributions), which are histogram/distribution plots rather than bar charts of means, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
